keyFindings: Landed directly on /task (no login wall) — session is authenticated as Ktrieling777@gmail.com, confirming prior agent's auth persisted.

Account is in a NON-EMPTY data state: sidebar 'Recent' section shows 9 existing tasks (mostly Chinese-language titles e.g. '苏州 AI Agent 开发工程师岗位搜索', '海辰储能合作分析报告'), so the true empty-state UI for a brand-new account was NOT observed on this run.

3 of the 9 recent task sidebar items rendered with an EMPTY title (button text/description both blank, only a 'More' menu button next to them) — could be legitimate in-progress AI-title-generation tasks (see flakiness playbook Pattern 9), or could be a data/rendering issue. Flagging as POTENTIAL ISSUE for follow-up rather than a confirmed bug, since this is a smoke-scope pass with no deep-dive into those specific task records.

Composer (TaskInput) hydration and interactivity confirmed working: filling the textbox correctly flips the Submit button from disabled to enabled, and clicking a scenario card correctly replaces composer content via fillText() without navigating away — matches source code behavior in task-index-client.tsx exactly, no signs of the SSR/hydration-race flakiness described in playbook §19b.
4 scenario cards ('Try these scenarios') rendered, matching the server-fetched scenarioCards table content for this account.
No console errors observed during the scan.
AI task creation was intentionally NOT submitted, per task instructions — Submit button was verified reachable/enabled but not clicked through to completion.
